findings.finding: The earlier optional microbubble proposal labelled tissue transfection percentages as cells. The primary histology method defines fluorescent positive area;the new note uses image-area wording and the distance exclusion.

Zhang compares joint formulation of two reporter RNAs against mixtures of single-RNA lipoplexes. Chen compares attachment of one-reporter lipoplexes to polymer microbubbles against administration beside the bubbles. These are distinct experimental questions.
The microbubble study reports lower spleen off-site signal for attachment,but liver differences were not statistically significant. No whole-body or clinical safety claim follows.
One Chen Discussion stability sentence is inconsistent with the wording in its Introduction. That sentence and its unverified mechanistic explanation were not adopted.

The static RNA-lipoplex reader retains an inherited Rojas key-paper superlative and clinical interpretation. Those connected-card claims and older Kranz,Rojas,Appelbaum,Di,Cheng,Rurik and Hunter assertions are not re-certified by this two-paper assessment.
